headline: Bitcoin Nears $80,000, Posts Biggest Weekly Rally In Three Years As Crypto Market Gains Momentum
summary: Bitcoin surged 24.5% in a week to near $80,000, its strongest weekly gain in over three years. The rally was driven by bond-market moves, ETF inflows and renewed investor optimism.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and its price is increasingly influenced by spot ETF flows and macro conditions such as interest rates.
why_moved: Bond-market moves and ETF inflows drove a sharp weekly rally, with renewed investor optimism adding to demand.
